tweetText: ChatGPT adoption is on the rise globally, with more users exploring its features and increasing usage. This growth highlights its impact across diverse regions and languages, showcasing its potential to transform communication. via OpenAI News
Trump has dropped restrictions on Anthropic’s AI models, Mythos and Fable. This creates uncertainty for companies navigating future AI regulations. via TechCrunch AI
Wayve has launched an $85M employee tender offer, valuing the company at $8.5B. This move highlights how AI startups are leveraging such offers to attract and keep top talent. via TechCrunch AI

A team of ex-DeepMind researchers launched EquiLibre Technologies, an AI lab now worth over $500 million, focusing on algorithms for quant hedge funds. Their success highlights the growing role of AI in finance. via TechCrunch AI
Google just launched Nano Banana 2 Lite, a faster and cheaper image generator. This upgrade will make it easier for creators to produce AI content efficiently. via TechCrunch AI

Etched, a competitor to Nvidia, has reached a $5B valuation and secured $1B in sales for its AI chip. This highlights growing competition in the AI chip market, crucial for tech advancement. via TechCrunch AI

Anthropic has launched Claude Sonnet 5, a more affordable AI model with enhanced capabilities and safety features. This move could make advanced AI more accessible and competitive in the market. via TechCrunch AI

Acti has launched a new smartphone keyboard that integrates AI agents, allowing users to create custom shortcuts with natural language. This could change how we interact with apps, making tasks faster and easier. via TechCrunch AI

Anthropic launched Claude Science, a unified platform for scientists to streamline their computational research. This could save time and enhance productivity in scientific workflows. via TechCrunch AI
X has launched a hosted MCP server to simplify connections between AI tools and its API. This move could enhance developer collaboration and innovation on the platform. via TechCrunch AI
